title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/18/2026
Reason for Admission: Fall from ladder with head trauma.

Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, SpO2 98% on room air, Temp 98.6 F.

Review of Systems:
Neurological: Positive (altered mental status, headache).
Respiratory: Negative.
Cardiovascular: Negative.
Musculoskeletal: Positive (neck pain).

HPI: Patient is a 50-year-old female who presented to the emergency department following a fall from a ladder. She was unconscious for about 10 minutes at the scene. Imaging was performed to evaluate for acute trauma.

Hospital Course: The patient was admitted for observation and management of a diffuse brain injury. MRI imaging confirmed the findings. She was monitored for neurological changes and stable vital signs. She remained stable throughout her stay and was cleared for discharge with home rest.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Diffuse axonal injury
- Traumatic brain injury

Discharge Medications:
- Acetaminophen 500mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.

Follow-up: Follow up with neurology clinic in 14 days.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, MD, 05/18/2026
explanations: Diffuse traumatic brain injury with loss of consciousness of 30 minutes or less, initial encounter: S06.2X1A (HCC 398).

distractors.why: There was a brief loss of consciousness.

hccs.label: Major Head Injury with Loss of Consciousness < 1 Hour or Unspecified
